parent_objective: execute the fixed 288-cell metric-specific bounded panel with the M1776 adapter
blocked_by: M1776 adapter implementation must pass before measured execution
supersedes: direct bounded-panel execution through the old scenario-taxonomy executor

public_gates: M1777 must execute exactly the M1771 bounded-panel specs and matrix
M1777 must target 288 episodes 24 bounded specs 12 profiles and 4 role panels
M1777 must write episode rows failure rows aggregates metric completeness and summary artifacts
M1777 must not train replay PPO promote use private holdout change actor inputs tune profiles rank controller families or claim paper-level evidence
M1777 interpretation must be deferred to M1778 result audit

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: executes the fixed 288-cell bounded panel as public diagnostic evidence
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: measured public diagnostic execution only; no training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if failure rows are nonzero
stop if target counts or role-panel aggregates are wrong
fallback_plan: route to measured-execution result audit if complete
route to failure audit if execution is incomplete or fails
route to adapter repair if artifact or metadata defects dominate

admission_evidence: M1776 implements bounded-panel execution adapter with focused tests
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1777 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for result audit or failure audit
next_stage_criteria: failure_count is zero or failures are preserved
metric completeness and no-ranking guardrails are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; bounded-panel execution is public diagnostic evidence and cannot alone prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: execution must preserve all controller profile controls for later history-necessity comparison
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1771 bounded panel artifacts and M1776 adapter only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If execution fails or profile outcomes are weak, route to result/failure audit without weakening self-ID claim standards.
allowed_claims: no training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1776 adapter can execute the fixed M1771 288-cell bounded panel and write complete diagnostic artifacts.
failure_criteria: target profile spec or role counts are wrong
training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes ranking or paper-level claims occur
decision_rule: M1777 passes if the fixed bounded panel completes with exact target counts, zero failures, complete metrics, and clean guardrails.
